description: Pushed authorisation request whose request parameter is not a JWT
settles: How PAR refuses a request object it cannot read, and with which status. The refusal's body was measured on 2026-09-01 and written down in docs/research/signed-requests.md, but never recorded, and that measurement did not note the status - so StubID's own 400 is an inference from RFC 9126 and from CAP-019. It also settles a value the measurement never sent: every probe there was a real JWS that failed validation, where this is not a JWS at all, which is the case StubID's tests actually drive. Authenticated, because CAP-019 shows an unauthenticated push is refused for that first and never reaches the object.
